rows.grounds: fused accusative feminine singular of brahmavidyāsvarūpa plus indeclinable ca; internal sandhi marks the conjunction
accusative feminine singular compound describing the goddess as bestower of both bhukti and mukti

items.question: Is the goddess's form as brahma-knowledge the source of both worldly enjoyment and final liberation?
premises: that form grants enjoyment and liberation
both fruits arise from one source
items.inference: the verse identifies brahma-knowledge's form as bestower of both bhukti and mukti
uncertainties: whether ca coordinates with a preceding predicate
items.plain_english: She is the very form of brahma-knowledge, granting the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.
